digest.component_or_area: Janitor approval phase for recovered RP-02–RP-06 reconciler/review-gate decisions
propositions: Each of RP-02–RP-06 requires an evidence-backed decision-ready brief mapping architectural intent, failure/edge scenarios, prior behavior to preserve, explicit behavior deltas, test oracles, migration hazards, and remaining maintainer-only choices

RP-02 transaction semantics require ordered exact-match retirement recovery at the live-operation boundary to close a production binding-state leak; reloading identity as simultaneously live and retired is not permitted

RP-03 failure handling must use a scoped finite-pass fuse (three consecutive exhausted logical outcomes across ≥2 tickets) with singular retry ownership, maximum 3 physical invocations per logical postcondition, ≤15 cumulative sleep per operation, and commit_unknown for lost-response writes

RP-04 operation-snapshot composition must enforce explicit > environment > project > user > default precedence with per-operation snapshot, separate secret/provider boundary, centralized defaults, and CLI-over-environment tracker precedence correction

RP-05 CLI registry must normalize canonical help for all 75 visible top-level commands, pre-route help/unknown before RP-04 snapshot/config/mount/handler/optional imports, support exact-alias reuse and compatibility-shim help, and generate docs from a single argparse factory per command family

RP-06 effective-policy discovery must apply routing predicates to project-criteria, use typed failures with Option-B drop-and-continue semantics for local failures, require non-empty applies_to globs for project-LLM criteria, honor explicit authored USD budgets, and enable explicit review-plan --retry only for eligible INDETERMINATE reviews with retryable missing calls
